sources.title: Visa Requirements for Traveling to Grenada
sources.publisher: Embassy of Grenada in the United States
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Embassy visitors page links this April 2024-updated nationality schedule, which directly names Timor-Leste and defines its prior-to-arrival classification.

sources.title: Regulation No. 795/2022 on visas — current Annex 9 exemption schedule
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official regulation record, dated 14 August 2026 and in force from 15 April 2025, lists East Timor in Annex 9's visa-exempt nationality cohort.

policies.title: Timor-Leste ordinary passports: Grenada prior-to-arrival visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy nationality schedule directly assigns Timor-Leste to the prior-to-arrival visitor-visa route.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Timor-Leste passport for short visitor travel.
Prior To Arrival means the visa must be obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The schedule was updated in April 2024 and should be rechecked early if Grenada publishes a later replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service and special-document routes are not classified.

policies.title: Timor-Leste ordinary passports: Iceland short-visitor visa exemption
policies.summary: Iceland's current visa regulation directly includes East Timor in its Annex 9 visa-exempt nationality schedule.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Timor-Leste passport for short visitor travel.
The rule is Iceland's own current Annex 9 nationality exemption; it is not inferred from an EU agreement.
Document validity, purpose, means, security checks and final border admission remain separate.
Work, residence, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless, crew and other special-document travel are not classified.
